features.name: dist_to_mean_prototype_l1
features.description: Manhattan (L1) distance of a sample to the training set's overall mean vector, calculated using a subset of four diverse descriptors (V8, V15, V30, V41). This measures how 'typical' a sample is relative to the data centroid.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly encodes the distance to the center of the data distribution, which can help k-NN identify outliers or samples in sparse regions, improving neighborhood geometry.

features.name: dist_to_extreme_prototype_l1
features.description: Manhattan (L1) distance of a sample to a prototype defined by the maximum observed values in the training set for a subset of four high-variance descriptors (V8, V16, V30, V41).
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps identify samples that are far from the 'high-value' extreme corner of the feature space, potentially separating them from samples that occupy that corner.

features.name: v36_normalized_range
features.description: The value of V36 scaled to a [0, 1] range based on the minimum and maximum values observed in the training set.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a min-max scaled version of V36, ensuring it has a comparable scale to other engineered features in the distance calculation, preventing it from unduly dominating the metric.

features.name: high_variance_uint_sum
features.description: Sum of three integer-based descriptors (V11, V16, V41) that exhibit high variance in the training data. This combines potentially important count-based features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a composite feature that amplifies the signal from several highly variable integer descriptors, potentially defining a new axis for separating data points.

features.name: charge_polarity_proxy
features.description: A proxy for the magnitude of charge or polarity, calculated as the Euclidean norm of the two descriptors (V12, V28) that can take negative values. This captures the combined effect regardless of sign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a single feature representing the magnitude of potential electrostatic effects, which can be a strong driver of molecular interactions and thus a useful distance metric.

features.name: is_v30_outlier
features.description: A binary flag indicating if descriptor V30 is exceptionally high (more than two standard deviations above the training set mean).
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates potential outliers into a distinct group, which can improve the local neighborhood calculations for other points by giving them a large distance to these outliers on this feature's axis.

features.name: descriptor_ratio_1
features.description: Ratio between V31 and V37, two float descriptors. Adding a small epsilon avoids division by zero and stabilizes the ratio for small denominator values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a scale-invariant feature that captures the relative relationship between two descriptors, which can be more informative for defining similarity than their absolute values.

features.name: rare_group_indicator_sum
features.description: Counts how many of a specific subset of four typically rare descriptors (V19, V24, V26, V29) are greater than zero for a given sample.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a discrete feature that groups samples based on the presence of rare structural motifs, which could define a meaningful and distinct cluster.

features.name: low_variance_float_interaction
features.description: An interaction term combining three float descriptors (V17, V18, V22) that have very low variance, potentially representing stable physical properties.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures subtle, non-linear relationships between stable descriptors, which might help refine neighborhood boundaries for otherwise similar samples.

features.name: molecular_complexity_proxy
features.description: A categorical assessment of molecular complexity. 0: Low complexity (low values across most descriptors, especially V8, V16, V30). 1: Medium complexity (moderate values). 2: High complexity (high values in several key descriptors like V8, V16, V30, V41).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a high-level, non-linear concept of complexity that might not be captured by simple formulas, potentially grouping structurally complex or simple molecules together.

features.name: descriptor_profile_shape
features.description: Categorizes the shape of the descriptor vector. 0: 'Spiky' profile, where one or two descriptors (e.g., V30, V41) are extremely high while others are low. 1: 'Flat' profile, where most descriptors have values near the typical (mean) range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distinguishes between molecules with unusual, specialized properties (spiky) and more 'average' molecules (flat), which could improve neighborhood definitions by separating these two groups.

features.name: high_low_value_interaction
features.description: Interaction between a high-magnitude feature (V8) and a low-magnitude feature (V27), normalized by another high-magnitude feature (V39) to control scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a feature that captures the interplay between descriptors of different scales, potentially revealing relationships that are otherwise obscured in standard distance metrics.
